title: office.private-route-check response
description: What the configured private endpoint accepted. capabilities, with the check time as verified_at, were recorded in .office/config.yaml and committed. Nothing private routes to an endpoint whose capabilities lack text.

path.description: Updated path relative to the Library.

label.description: The endpoint's label from settings, shown wherever the route is used.

route.description: The derived_by.route private calls to this endpoint record.

model.description: The model named in the requests (open_weights.model).

reported_model.description: The model name the endpoint reported in its first usable reply, or null.

capabilities.description: Capabilities recorded: the requests the endpoint answered, in check order.

routable.description: Whether private material can now route here (the text request passed).

checks.description: One entry per request, in order: text (a sentence), image (a 1x1 PNG), audio (a 1-second silent WAV).

elapsed_ms.description: How long an accepted request took; null when it failed.

error.description: The failure code when not accepted (for example model_request_rejected or model_unavailable); never a response body.

note.description: What a failed request means, in plain words; null when accepted.
